**New function** — `src/main/java/.../rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreation.java`:

Because the step runs only after every validation/quota/save step succeeds (all earlier steps throw on failure, which short-circuits via escalation handlers), the log fires only on genuinely successful creations.
